why: Build step for slice S6 of docs/plan/quests/port-scripts-0113-PLAN.md, env.sh's values as a shared Env service, on branch fabrikalfa/port-0113-s06 from the tests step's head 668b313. Wrote .agents/skills/lead/scripts/Env.ts: the Values record, the Env service (key lead/Env), its real layer on Git, FileSystem and Path with every outside value read through Config (set and not empty wins, over local.env too), layerTest for a fixed record, and read, the values on this machine (the layer on GitProcess run from the scripts folder, as env.sh runs git from its own, and NodeServices). Added commonDir, remote and globalConfig to the Git contract and to GitProcess (rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir; remote get-url, none on exit 2; config --global --get, none on exit 1). Moved the readers off spawning env.sh: drive.ts (its Env type is now a Pick of Values, so drive.test.ts's literal env objects need no new field; its main reads Env before the step), chain.ts (it called drive's loadEnv, which is gone; it reads Env first), gc.ts, land.ts (HOME and FABRIKA_HOME through Config, as env.sh's shell gave them), gcloop.ts (paths) and flow/run.ts (boxes); box.ts's top comment says where its MAIN and BOXES come from. env.sh's line 17 comment names fieldrow.ts; its behavior is unchanged. Added Env.ts and Env.test.ts to .agents/tsconfig.json, so the typecheck reads them. All laws green with no law or GitTest.ts touched.
note: Cloud twin build step, one session, no subagents. The date is the UTC day; the times are Pacific. Laws run one file at a time under nice -n 15 vitest --maxWorkers=3: Env.test.ts 2, the git integration law file 4 (the new real-layer law included, run here with no override; the 0178 guard allowed it), governance.test.ts 2, drive.test.ts 65, chain.test.ts 63, gc.test.ts 15, land.test.ts 10, gcloop.test.ts 11, quests.test.ts 20, box.test.ts 47; there is no flow run test. --changed origin/main was refused by the test config as a broad run. A first pnpm format ran while drive.ts held a duplicate name, so oxlint could not parse it and pruned its 18 agents-ledger.json entries; agents-ledger.json was restored from HEAD and the next format pruned nothing. pnpm lint with NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144 under the box's lock: all 19 parts passed. The list ratchet exits 0. pnpm typecheck passed whole once, then the .agents project's typecheck again after Env.ts and Env.test.ts joined its include list. Smoke runs on this machine: gcloop.ts plist named the main checkout from inside a worktree, gc.ts --dry-run printed its no-boxes line, and gc.ts --bad kept exit 2. One difference from env.sh that no law reads: env.sh asks MAIN's origin for REMOTE, Env asks the scripts' own repository, the same folder unless MAIN is set from outside to another checkout. Committed with stepcommit.sh --commit-only, so nothing is signed.
